subject: Co-sell calendar wrangling: marketplace preview & SI rehearsal
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy@edgescale.com>, AWS Partner Team <aws-partners@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell marketplace preview — proposed dates + agenda

Hi Lucy / AWS partners —

Thanks for agreeing to take this public preview with us. High level ask: a 60-minute co-sell/demo session that covers the Redwood marketplace listing and a short SI-led technical walkthrough showing how the integration will be represented in the marketplace. Target audience: EdgeScale pre-sales + selected AWS field reps.

Proposed live slots (PT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:00 (preferred)
- Wed Aug 4, 09:00–10:00 (backup)

Agenda (attached: redwood_marketplace_preview_agenda.pdf):
- 10m intro and positioning (Vanessa)
- 20m live demo: Redwood API + marketplace flow (Ben)
- 20m SI-led integration deep dive (Karthik)
- 10m Q&A / next steps

Two coordination asks:
1) Can we run a 30–45m dry-run with the SI and AWS field team one business day prior?
2) Please confirm preferred live slot + attendee list (we’ll publish invites once confirmed).

I’m looping Ben and Karthik to coordinate tech ops. If either of the proposed slots is a hard no for AWS, flag alternatives and we’ll reorganize.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_preview_agenda.pdf
From: Lucy Park <lucy@edgescale.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Partner Team <aws-partners@amazon.com>, EdgeScale Execs <execs@edgescale.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace preview — proposed dates + agenda

Vanessa —

Appreciate the agenda; this looks great. Quick flag from our side: our lead AWS field rep is at re:Invent prep the week of Aug 1–4 and asked whether we can move the live session to Thu Aug 5 or Fri Aug 6. The SI team (EdgeScale Professional Services) can cover the SI-led segment on Aug 3 if we keep it earlier in the week, but the AWS field presence is important for co-sell signals.

Also: we absolutely want a dry-run. Ideally that’s 45 minutes and includes the AWS field rep + SI lead + one solutions architect to validate the marketplace flow (especially SSO and payload mapping).

Proposed alternatives from EdgeScale:
- Dry-run: Wed Aug 3, 08:00–08:45 PT (we can do this)
- Live: Thu Aug 5, 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri Aug 6, 09:00–10:00 PT

If moving live to Aug 5/6 is a blocker for Redwood, we can try to find a delegate from AWS for Aug 3 but would prefer not to.

Thanks —
Lucy Park
Head of Partnerships | EdgeScale
lucy@edgescale.com | +1 (206) 555-3321

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy@edgescale.com>, AWS Partner Team <aws-partners@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace preview — proposed dates + agenda

Thanks Lucy — appreciate the heads-up on re:Invent prep. We can absolutely slide the live session to Aug 5 or Aug 6. To keep momentum, here’s a proposal that covers both the dry-run and live availability:

Proposed schedule (PT):
- Dry-run (mandatory): Wed Aug 3, 08:00–08:45 — calendar file attached (calendar-dryrun.ics)
- Live session (pick one): Thu Aug 5, 10:00–11:00 OR Fri Aug 6, 09:00–10:00

If AWS confirms Aug 5 or Aug 6, we’ll lock the live session and Ben will lead the demo; Karthik will do the SI deep-dive. Marissa, can you please reserve both live slots in Redwood’s calendar as tentative until we get final confirmation from AWS?

Notes:
- Dry-run will focus on the marketplace demo flow + SSO handshake (please have an SA on the line with test credentials).
- We’ll circulate final slides after the dry-run and request any content redlines by EOD Aug 3.

Lucy — please confirm which live day you prefer and who from AWS will be on the invite. If either of the live days conflicts with other exec plans, we can fall back to your delegate suggestion.

Best,
Vanessa

Attachments: calendar-dryrun.ics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace preview — proposed dates + agenda

Looping in availability from EdgeScale Professional Services (I spoke with Priya on the team). We can do the dry-run Wed Aug 3 08:00 PT — I’ll be on the call and will bring the integration runbook. For the live session, Aug 5 10:00 PT works best for us; Aug 6 would be OK but we prefer Aug 5 to align with our delivery window.

One flag: if we get APAC attendees from EdgeScale or AWS, the 10:00 PT slot translates to evening/APAC midnight for some SAs — we should call that out when confirming attendees. I’ll prepare a concise tech checklist for the dry-run (SSO test user, token scopes, and sample payloads).

Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-2408
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy@edgescale.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, AWS Partner Team <aws-partners@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell marketplace preview — proposed dates + agenda

Thanks everyone — locking this down.

Final schedule (PT):
- Dry-run (required): Wed Aug 3, 08:00–08:45 — calendar invite sent (see calendar link)
- Live co-sell demo: Thu Aug 5, 10:00–11:00 — invite sent to Lucy, AWS Partner Team, EdgeScale execs and Redwood hosts

Action items assigned:
- EdgeScale: confirm AWS attendee list and test credentials for dry-run (Lucy)
- AWS: confirm primary field rep or delegate (aws-partners@amazon.com)
- Redwood: finalize slides and publish final-agenda.pdf by EOD Aug 3 (Ben + Karthik)
- Marissa: will create the HubSpot event and attach the finalized slides + co-marketing checklist (Doc sent after dry-run).

We’ll also add a 15-minute prep call for Redwood hosts only on Aug 4 09:00 PT to walk through talk-tracks.

Thanks — looking forward to this.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0487

Attachments: final-agenda.pdf
